plotEn:
Three months after dismantling the idol statue thief Varman's smuggling operations and killing his own son Arjun, retired jailer Muthuvel Pandian lives a secluded life with his wife Viji, daughter-in-law Swetha and grandson Rithvik near Anaikatti, Coimbatore, working as a supermarket supervisor. His family remains unaware that he killed Arjun. Varman's close friend and associate, Dileep, another idol statue thief, hires an investigator named Mukund to identify Varman's killer.
Muthuvel is manipulated by self-proclaimed gangster and fruit seller Moorthi, into becoming his driver. He encounters a former ally Vimal, who has since become involved in statue smuggling. Recognising an opportunity to infiltrate Dileep's operations, Muthuvel secretly arranges for Moorthi to establish contact with Dileep through Vimal while maintaining his identity as an ordinary driver. However, Mukund's investigation eventually leads to Muthuvel's identification after his image is captured during the filming of a musical sequence for actor Blast Mohan's upcoming film.
Dileep corners Muthuvel at a facility while his henchmen reach Muthuvel's family home. However, Muthuvel reveals that he anticipated the attack and had planted several infiltrators within Dileep's organisation, who eliminate his men. Muthuvel's family is rescued by his allies Mathew, Narasimha and Kamdev.
